hooks.logic:
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame, then
  Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
  Let turnInBattle be the script register's 'turnInBattle'.
  Let number be the numeric entry "turns_to_disp_message_1" in the battle settings of the enemy.
  Let number2 be the numeric entry "turns_to_disp_message_2" in the battle settings of the enemy.
  If turnInBattle is number, then part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "02", buddyId: the character RAMZA}]]}.
  Otherwise, if turnInBattle is number2, then part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "03", buddyId: the character DELITA}]]}.
  Increase the script register's 'turnInBattle' by one.
Run helper3.
If part 2 of the enemy is alive, then run helper4.
If part 3 of the enemy is alive, then run helper5.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Return not (the first x in arg where the value "no" of x is 1) or (if the current state is 91 then (do given (part) { Finish off part. } for each item of the parts of the acting enemy, then true) else (the current state is 90 or change state to 90, then false)).

script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the acting enemy.
Let part3 be part 3 of the acting enemy.
Let agrasBpConfsIdx be the script register's 'agrasBpConfsIdx'.
Let v be agrasBpConfsIdx.
Set v to if part2 is dead and part3 is dead then the length of data at 1 minus 1 else helper2 → call with (this state, 1, agrasBpConfsIdx).
If agrasBpConfsIdx is not v, then
  Set the script register's 'agrasBpConfsIdx' to v.
  Helper → call with (this state, 1, v).
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
